title: Half-biased and ordinary BPP
statement: The class of languages decidable in polynomial time with a finite nondeterministic Turing machine whose choice bits are independently true with probability $1/2$, and with acceptance probability at least $2/3$ on every input, is equal to the ordinary class BPP defined using uniformly random choice bits and the same time and acceptance bounds.
